problem.unreachable.message: {server} didn't answer. Check that the server is running and its address is right, then try again.
problem.unreachable.note: an MCP server couldn't be reached

problem.refused: {server} refused ReputeCast's credentials. A manager can replace the shared secret in Settings › Integrations · MCP servers.

problem.elsewhere.message: {server} asked ReputeCast to send its requests to another address. They go only to the address entered for the server, so nothing was sent there. Check the server's address in Settings › Integrations · MCP servers.
problem.elsewhere.note: an MCP server (its HTTP with SSE endpoint) named another origin, or plain http for an https server; the request was refused

problem.signIn.message: Sign in to {server} to use its tools: your sign-in is missing or expired.
problem.signIn.note: OAuth per member; the panel offers Reconnect

problem.toolChanged: {tool} changed or was removed since it was approved. A manager has to review it again before it runs.
problem.toolBlocked: A manager blocked {tool}. It doesn't run.
problem.timeout: {server} took too long to answer. Try again later.
problem.tooLarge: {server} answered with more than {kb} KB. The result wasn't read.
problem.url: This address can't be used: {reason}. Use the server's public https:// address.
problem.input: Check the server's name, authentication and credentials: they don't fit together.
problem.state: This sign-in link expired or was already used. Start the sign-in again from Settings › Integrations · MCP servers.

problem.oauth.message: {server}'s sign-in couldn't be set up: its authorization server didn't answer as expected. Check the address or enter a registered client.
problem.oauth.note: OAuth discovery, registration or token failure

problem.noClient.message: {server}'s authorization server doesn't let ReputeCast register itself. A manager can register a client with it, using the redirect URI shown, and enter its client ID (and secret) in Settings › Integrations · MCP servers.
problem.noClient.note: no pre-registered client, no Client ID Metadata Document support, no dynamic registration

problem.clientAuth.message: {server}'s authorization server accepts only client authentication ReputeCast doesn't support, such as private_key_jwt. ReputeCast signs in as a public client (none) or with a client secret (client_secret_basic or client_secret_post): register a client that uses one of those.
problem.clientAuth.note: token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported lists none of none, client_secret_basic, client_secret_post

problem.reviewed: {tool} changed since you reviewed it. Review its new description and schema, then decide again.
notify.changedBody: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} of {server} changed after they were approved and are off until you review them.
